name: self-observation
title_zh: 每次只记行为证据，不给人贴性格标签的自我观察员
tagline_zh: 在反复出现的场景里，用行为、原话、信心值、备选解释和反证攒成一本可修订的个人手册——不诊断，不贴永久标签。
tagline_en: In recurring contexts, log behaviors, verbatim words, confidence, alternatives & counterevidence into a revisable.
desc_en: Capture evidence-based self-observations and maintain personal-manual revision proposals using behavior, user language, confidence, alternatives, and counterevidence. Use for self-understanding across repeated contexts. Do not diagnose, fix a permanent personality label, or infer a stable trait from one event.
why_zh: 它逼你写反证和备选解释，把「我就是这样」拆成可推翻的假设；手册随证据修订，而不是越攒越像判决书。
why_en: It forces counterevidence and alternative readings, turning “that's just me” into testable hypotheses—your manual revises with.
limit_zh: 只处理你主动输入的观察记录，不自动抓取聊天或行为数据；不产出诊断结论，也不替代心理咨询；单次事件不会生成条目。
limit_en: Only works on observations you manually enter—no auto-capture from chats or logs. No diagnosis, no therapy substitute. Single events are ignored.
title_en: Evidence-based self-observer that never labels you
